FX-SOLAR-001.says: Threshold 128, as it starts: every channel at 128 or above is turned over. The grey #808080, on the threshold, turns #7f7f7f, while #7f7f7f beside it, one below, stays; the light grey turns #3f3f3f and the white black; the skin turns a deep blue #092941 (red, green and blue all above 128); the red trace keeps its green and blue and its red falls to 55; the night blue keeps its red and green and its blue falls to 101; black, the line and the dark grey, all below, stay as they are.

FX-SOLAR-002.says: Threshold 0: every channel of every shown pixel is turned over, as Invert does: black turns white, white black, the skin #092941.

FX-SOLAR-003.says: Threshold 255: only a channel already at full is turned over, so the white turns black and every other pixel stays as it is.

FX-SOLAR-004.says: Threshold 1: every channel above 0 is turned over, so black, all at 0, stays black, while every other shown pixel is inverted as in FX-SOLAR-002.

FX-SOLAR-005.says: Threshold 64: the dark grey, on the threshold, turns #bfbfbf; the line, below it, stays; the night blue keeps its red 58 and turns over its green and blue, to #3aa565.

FX-SOLAR-006.says: Threshold 129: the grey #808080 and its soft edge, now one below, stay as they are; the light grey, the skin and the white are turned over as in FX-SOLAR-001.

FX-SOLAR-007.says: Threshold 200: the skin turns over its red and green and keeps its blue 190, to #0929be, a blue-purple; the red trace's red, on the threshold, falls to 55; the light grey, 192, stays; the white turns black.

FX-SOLAR-008.says: Threshold 127.5, between two 8-bit values: the same as 128, FX-SOLAR-001, as no written value lies between them.

FX-SOLAR-009.says: Threshold keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 255 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-SOLAR-002, frame 2 (127.5) FX-SOLAR-001 and frame 4 FX-SOLAR-003.

FX-SOLAR-010.says: Threshold keyed 64 at frame 0, held, then 200 at frame 4: frames 0 and 2 are FX-SOLAR-005 and frame 4 FX-SOLAR-007.

FX-SOLAR-011.says: Threshold eased from 128 at frame 0 to 255 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it has gone past 255 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 are both FX-SOLAR-003.

FX-SOLAR-012.says: FX-SOLAR-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-SOLAR-013.says: Threshold -1: below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SOLAR-014.says: Threshold 255.5: above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SOLAR-015.says: Threshold keyed to 300 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SOLAR-016.says: Threshold keyed from -50 at frame 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
